source.title: Quality Prediction in a Mining Process

protocol.sampling: median of approximately 180 sensor rows per nominal hour; changing/interpolated lab-label hours excluded
protocol.splits: three disjoint chronological future windows; expanding history; at least 24 h train/test embargo
protocol.interpretation: observational one-plant quality forecast; no causal control effect, recovery or transfer claim
protocol.previous_lab_caveat: persistence comparator assumes previous hourly lab assay is already available
